title: Cordon agent judge (cordon.judge/v1)
description: K9. The exchange behind `cordon scan --judge cordon-cloud`: the package POSTs one piece of agent-facing text to {CORDON_CLOUD_URL}/v1/judge with the sign-in bearer token, and the cloud answers with one verdict. The package checks that the verdict's evidence is a quote from the text it sent and reports nothing when it is not, so the cloud cannot add a finding the text does not support. Only agent-facing text is sent: instruction files, skills, slash commands, MCP tool descriptions and agent hook commands, never other source.

prompt_version.description: The package's judge prompt version (`judge-1`). The cloud may run its own prompt and model, but caches and reports per version so a change of prompt is a change of identity.

path.description: The file's path inside the scan target.

text.description: One piece of the file, cut at paragraph breaks.

evidence.description: An exact quote from `text`, empty when benign. A quote not found in the text discards the verdict.
